_comment: Over-ceiling complete_checkout. Prior running_total=8500 was committed by earlier checkouts in the same session and is pre-populated at input.context.session.policies.<writer_id>. 8500 + 3000 = 11500 > budget 10000, so the projected session total breaks the ceiling: allow=false, a reason is emitted, and NO session write is made (a blocked checkout must not advance the running total). input.context.mandate.session_budget is DTwo-supplied policy input, NOT a UCP field.
